# Skids track TRACK2-6. Lines starting with # are comments.
#
# The picture is track.png: 1024x512, 16 colours. Its palette is the
# track's palette. Colours 8-15 are road, 0-7 are scenery (dusty).
#
# gate x1 y1 x2 y2: lap gates in race order, in world units. Gate 0 is
# the start/finish line; the grid forms up behind it. The gates' ends
# also shape the walls: each edge of the road is a smooth curve
# through the matching ends of the gates. World to picture, for a
# point at height z (pixels):
#   picture x = wx - wy + 512, picture y = (wx + wy) / 2 - 156 - z
